# Activating current-first contributions

This is a one-time maintainer checklist. Merging the guidance does not itself change repository settings, install labels, or make an Action a required check.

1. **Protect `main-cli` first.** Set appropriate review, CLA, and existing CI requirements. Do not change the default onto an unprotected branch or remove existing protections from `main`.
2. **Audit default-branch consumers.** Review scheduled/issue workflows, Dependabot, Actions permissions, and documentation links. In particular, a bare `--template=https://github.com/Shopify/shopify-app-template-react-router` or clone without a branch follows the default; older CLIs using that explicit URL are not protected by the built-in branch mapping. Preserve an explicit `#main` path for older-template documentation before switching. Carry required default-branch automation deliberately, not by merging the divergent app branches.
3. **Bootstrap the guard on both target branches.** Merge it into `main-cli` and intentionally carry `.github/workflows/check-pr-target.yml` into `main` as a one-time maintainer update. `pull_request_target` uses trusted base-branch workflow code, so installing it only on `main-cli` must not be assumed to guard PRs targeting `main`. Keep the linked guidance available on `main-cli`. Do not require the check before its workflow exists on the relevant base. Also check the JavaScript conversion after this workflow-changing PR: if workflow-file publication is rejected by the bot token, a maintainer must publish that reviewed update through the normal authorized path; do not add a broad token or assume conversion succeeded.
4. **Create the manual labels.** `legacy-template` means a maintainer has intentionally selected an older-template PR; it is not a compatibility certification. `backport-main` marks optional work for maintainers, not contributors. Normal repository label permissions and review requirements still apply.
5. **Verify hosted behavior before enforcement.** With disposable draft PRs, confirm `main` without the label fails, adding/removing the label reruns the check, retargeting to `main-cli` passes, and a fork PR can read metadata with the restricted token. Confirm GitHub evaluates the latest run for the intended PR/head after label changes or cancellation; a green run alone does not prove required-check behavior. Do not add secrets or execute PR code to make this work. Local fixtures do not establish hosted behavior.
6. **Switch the default to `main-cli`.** After the consumer audit and protections, change the repository default and check that ordinary new PRs and dependency updates target the intended branch. Dependabot currently follows the default, so do this before enforcing the guard on `main`. Keep `main` and `javascript` in place for older consumers; this is not a branch rename or a CLI support-policy change.
7. **Require `Check PR target` after handling existing PRs.** Review existing PRs to `main`: deliberately retarget them or confirm the legacy exception, and trigger a fresh check run before requiring it (PRs predating installation may have no run). Select the observed GitHub Actions check for `main` in its protection/ruleset, retaining existing gates. Verify the intended bypass permissions; adding a workflow alone does not prevent merges. This workflow does not handle `merge_group`: do not require it with a merge queue until a corresponding queue check is implemented and verified. Do not require it for unrelated historical branches where it is not installed.
8. **Complete current-CLI JavaScript delivery.** Check the existing conversion workflow and the PR targeting `javascript-cli`, including dependency changes, then merge through normal review. Do not count an open conversion PR as delivery. Repeat that small follow-through for normal template changes.

No step authorizes automatically merging app changes, backporting every PR, or changing older-CLI support obligations. If the target check misbehaves, remove its required-check setting before disabling/removing the workflow so intentional updates are not left waiting on an absent check; keep the written contribution guidance.
